groups.why_chosen: The general point-based neural rendering pipeline reduces to three per-tile steps: project each scene ellipsoid to an image-plane ellipse, sort the intersecting ellipses by depth, and blend their colours front-to-back to shade the pixel.
groups.what_to_learn: matching upper-case 3D objects to lower-case 2D projections via colour and a projection line, with a magnified tile inset showing pixel-level detail
